programs.title: Solar System
programs.desc: The host of the program, Professor Brian Cox, presents selected information about the solar system.Viewers will learn about planets and moons covered with volcanoes that erupt with fire and ice.In the following parts, the scientist talks about the most interesting atmospheric conditions that were noticed on celestial bodies neighboring the Earth.He visits landscapes created by dust whirls, mountains covered with metallic frost and monsoon rains on one of the moons.In addition, Professor Cox will introduce viewers to frozen regions of the solar system, including a dwarf planet with mountains of solid ice floating on it, as well as a black and white moon.

programs.title: World's Most Amazing Walks
programs.desc: Robson Green gained popularity, among others, thanks to the role of an experienced detective in the crime series "Grantchester".Privately, the actor is a great lover of hiking and fishing.The new series documents eight expeditions along selected tourist routes in Europe.The artist traveled, among others, the northern coast of Normandy, following in the footsteps of soldiers taking part in a key battle of World War II.On the Trail of the Eagles' Nests in Poland, he had the opportunity to admire impressive landscapes and the ruins of medieval castles.A monument to a bygone era. Robson Green begins exploring the most beautiful trekking routes in the world in his native Great Britain.Hadrian's Wall is one of the most important monuments of ancient Rome on the Islands.The trail, divided into stages, is 135 kilometers long.It has special meaning for the actor because he grew up in this area.He follows familiar paths through the rugged moors.He has loved this landscape since childhood.He is amazed not only by nature, but also by the heritage of the past.He gets to know, among other things, Vindolanda - a Roman camp built in the 1st century.Archaeologists still make discoveries here related to the times of the Roman Empire.
